cases.name: conditions-read-fields-three-pools-deep
cases.description: An if= and an <assert> read D.room.dept.dep_id the way a formula and the output do — the validator refused both until the whole path was checked.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="r7" local="en"><pool name="Depts" count="3"><sequence name="dep_id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence></pool><pool name="Rooms" count="6"><sequence name="room_id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="dept"><gen type="pool" value="Depts"/></sequence></pool><pool name="Docs" count="4"><sequence name="doc_id"><gen type="increment" value="1"/></sequence><sequence name="room"><gen type="pool" value="Rooms"/></sequence></pool><sequence name="D"><gen type="pool" value="Docs"/></sequence><sequence name="Tag"><gen type="text" value="first-dept" if="D.room.dept.dep_id == 1"/><gen type="text" value="other"/></sequence><assert each="D.room.dept.dep_id >= 1" says="every doctor sits in a department"/></env><block><line><data>${{D.doc_id}}|${{D.room.room_id}}|${{D.room.dept.dep_id}}|${{Tag}}</data></line></block></tdc>
